summary: Two Dark Elf foundations and eight sea-raider/Warhound templates

profiles.name: Dark Elf

traits.name: Hatred
traits.adaptation: Legacy: core Hatred uses a Psychology Test and the current Melee/Ranged and immunity rules, replacing the p. 18 summary.

traits.name: Night Vision
traits.adaptation: Legacy: core Night Vision works in natural darkness without the dim-light prerequisite printed on p. 18.

profiles.adaptation: Legacy: core Hatred and Night Vision replace the differing p. 18 summaries; printed Characteristics, Wounds and Damage are unchanged.
notes: Generic GM foundation only; this is not a playable Dark Elf Species. Printed optional Armour 3 is an unspecified protection profile, not invented pieces.
Printed Weapon +7 is unnamed. Optional Ranged +9 has range 60 yards and no named weapon. Optional Spellcaster requires an explicit Lore.

profiles.name: Dark Elf Ship's Crew

talents.name: Old Salt
talents.adaptation: Legacy: Core Old Salt can use the units die as SL on successful ocean Row/Sail Tests, replacing the p. 18 poor-condition immunity; the two-crew benefit remains.

talents.name: Pilot
talents.adaptation: Legacy: Core Pilot grants Advantage on Row and Sail, replacing the p. 18–19 failed-roll reversal.

talents.name: Sea Legs
talents.adaptation: Legacy: Core Sea Legs grants Advantage when a seasickness Test is required, replacing the printed abnormal-condition penalty immunity.

talents.name: Strong Swimmer
talents.adaptation: Legacy: Core Strong Swimmer grants Swim Advantage and +2 SL in swimming Pursuits, replacing the p. 18–19 breath-holding Toughness Bonus.

profiles.adaptation: Legacy: Perform Singing/Storytelling uses core Entertain; the four core sailing Talents replace the specific differing older effects noted on their grants.
notes: The p. 7 heading 'Traits' contains Skills; they are recorded as Skills. This is the printed fixed Dark Elf Ship's Crew profile, not bonuses applied over another foundation. Choose one performance and one instrument. Named Trappings retain their printed quantities and do not invent attack statistics.

skillSlots.label: Singing or Storytelling
skillSlots.adaptation: Legacy: printed Perform (Singing or Storytelling) uses core Entertain and Fellowship, with the printed +5 Skill bonus.

templates.name: Beastmaster

talents.adaptation: Legacy: Core Animal Affinity concerns non-aggressive wild animals, replacing the p. 19 Bestial-Trait condition.
Legacy: Core Crack the Whip uses Drive, animal Actions/Tests and Pursuit Movement, replacing the p. 19 whip-dependent fleeing/running bonus.

gear.label: Whip
gear.adaptation: Legacy: use the core Melee (Flail) Whip; the printed Ranged (Entangling) Skill bonus is retained unchanged. Crop has no supplied profile and is unavailable.

notes: Template Skill bonuses use the higher of existing advances and the printed bonus, following the reviewed core-template interpretation. All printed Characteristic columns are applied exactly; current core Talent definitions govern.

Choose a mount specialisation for Ride +15 and an explicit melee or ranged Net. Crop is unavailable; the approved core Whip is granted without changing the printed Skill bonuses. No animal is automatically granted.

templates.name: Druchii Sorceress

talents.adaptation: Legacy: Core Aethyric Attunement uses the current Minor/Major Miscast choices, replacing the printed successful-Casting-doubles immunity. The printed '(Any)' is removed because this is not a grouped core Talent.

traits.name: Spellcaster
traits.value: Beasts, Death, Fire, Heavens, Life, Light, Metal, Shadows, Witchcraft, Dark Magic
traits.adaptation: Legacy: the approved core Spellcaster grant preserves this template's printed mixed-Colour, Witchcraft and Dark Magic access; Arcane Magic and Channelling still require explicit matching choices.

notes: Template Skill bonuses use the higher of existing advances and the printed bonus, following the reviewed core-template interpretation. All printed Characteristic columns are applied exactly; current core Talent definitions govern.

Choose a core Colour Lore for Arcane Magic and its matching Channelling Wind. The approved Spellcaster adaptation permits exactly seven spells across the eight Colour Lores, Witchcraft and Dark Magic, plus five Petty spells. No PC starting allocation or playable Dark Elf Species is granted.

templates.name: Warhound
templates.adaptation: Legacy: the printed Fourth Edition Dog reference uses the core Fifth Edition Dog and Small-to-Average Size adjustment (+10 S/T, −5 Ag). Broken uses a recorded 2d10 Fellowship roll; Guard grants Territorial and War adds +10 WS under core p. 363.
notes: Generic Warhound recipe only; no named owner or pack. Existing printed Tracker is retained once. Broken allows ignoring Bestial; War allows ignoring Skittish for loud noises. Those Traits remain listed because training does not remove their other effects.
